2022–2026 · College & community

Muhlenberg College

Four years of academics, clubs, creative work, friendships, campus events, and exploring Allentown. I graduated in May 2026 with a B.S. in Computer Science and a minor in Innovation & Entrepreneurship.

An Education Across My Interests

At Muhlenberg, I studied Computer Science alongside Innovation & Entrepreneurship, with additional studies in writing and art. My interests often overlapped: technical projects, creative writing, entrepreneurial ideas, and communities I helped organize.

I made the Dean’s List in my final three semesters. Outside class, much of my time went into student organizations, campus events, friendships, and getting to know the area around the college.

Life Around the College

I enjoyed the local parks, walking around residential Allentown, and visiting the Farmers Market. Those everyday outings belong alongside the academic and campus experiences in how I remember college.

Among my friends, I was often the person inviting people over, making plans, and keeping everyone in touch. Building those connections was another meaningful part of my time here.
